description: Converts international domain names between Unicode and Punycode (xn--) one name at a time, up to 20 names, and warns about mixed-script look-alike names.

direction.description: auto picks the direction from the input. ascii encodes to Punycode, unicode decodes. Defaults to auto.

domains.description: Domain names to convert, such as münchen.de or xn--mnchen-3ya.de.

name: punycode_convert
title: Punycode converter
